question_text: I see a slight dip in your marks between 10th and 12th grade. What were the reasons for this?
Why did you choose your specific stream of study in college?
Describe your relationship with your father. How has he influenced your personality?
What do your friends usually like about you, and what is one thing they would want you to change?
Why do you want to join the Armed Forces? Why not a high-paying corporate job?
If you are not selected this time, what is your immediate backup plan?
